_note: 1_10 'Halloween' — the time-stopped night: Gary leads the player to a parking-lot ambush, then down into the janitor basement and across it to the Hole, where the Russell-fight audience is already gathering (recon: docs/re-notes/ch1/1_10-halloween.md). v1 simplifications (see the recon's gap table): the baked 1-10 cutscene is a title card + speech beat; the five puzzle rooms (plain switch, cage, broom, electric floor, furnace) compress to one switch beat + the long dark walk (the switch is the v1 hold-interact; the broom/cage/crawl/extinguisher mechanics are traversal + prop work for later); the door lock/unlock choreography is skipped; Gary is untargetable (his KO fail is latent); the betrayal cutscene itself belongs to 1_B's intro. The clock is NOT touched here — the night is time-stopped from 1_09's pass (its on_pass pauses the clock), matching the original. No pass grants (the original has no SMissPass entry for 1_10). Wording is original; ped_model_id records the original model ids next to the stand-in meshes.
